print_basics.skill: Print fixed characters, the alphabet or digits with write

program_args.skill: Use argc and argv: print, pick or add up the arguments

option_flags.skill: Read the options of a program from its arguments, like -abc

string_basics.skill: Rewrite the basic string functions: length, copy, compare, print, reverse

pointers.skill: Change the caller's values through pointers

char_transform.skill: Transform each character of a string: rotation, case, mirror, repetition, replacement

words.skill: Find one word of a string: the first one, the last one

clean_words.skill: Clean up or spread the spaces between the words of a string

reorder_words.skill: Display the words of a string in another order

case_style.skill: Change the writing style of words: camelCase, snake_case, capitals

char_sets.skill: Compare the characters of two strings: found in both, in one only, in order

number_parse.skill: Turn a string written in base 10 into an integer

base_parse.skill: Turn a string written in another base into an integer

number_print.skill: Print integers in base 10 with write

print_in_base.skill: Print an integer in another base with write

number_string.skill: Turn an integer into a new string, allocated, in base 10 or another base

arithmetic.skill: Integer operations: a small calculator, a multiplication table

primes.skill: Divisors, gcd, lcm and prime numbers

bits.skill: Read and change the bits of a byte or an integer

allocation.skill: Copy a string into new memory allocated with malloc

int_ranges.skill: Build a new array of ints with malloc: a range of numbers

split.skill: Split a string into an allocated array of words

int_arrays.skill: Go through an array of integers to find a value in it

int_sort.skill: Sort an array of integers in place

linked_lists.skill: Go through a linked list: count or read its nodes

list_changes.skill: Change a linked list: remove, move or sort its nodes, find a cycle

grids.skill: Explore a 2D grid of characters, like a flood fill

stack_parsing.skill: Read an expression with a stack: brackets that match, reverse Polish notation

interpreters.skill: Run a tiny language: a tape of bytes, a pointer and loops

memory_dump.skill: Print the bytes of memory in hexadecimal and as characters

string_search.skill: Search inside a string, like the longest palindrome
